scientific_integrity: Original claim is limited to the exact parameter range and continuous-time objective of the proof. Analytic inequalities establish the general theorem; finite checks are corroboration, not exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted optimizer uniqueness is asserted only for cyclic cores; transitive-core existence and orbit-constant uniqueness do not imply unrestricted uniqueness for every core.
The stationary distribution is uniform, and all edge-transition rates are symmetric.
The derived spectral-gap rate does not optimize discrete-time SLEM or worst-case hitting times.
Priority remains subject to specialist examination and independent mathematical validation.
title: Exact price-optimal continuous-time mixing on transitive one-leaf coronas and rigid cyclic sunlets
